lines.learner: 눈이 아프고 귀도 아파요. 어느 과로 가야 해요?
lines.en: My eyes and ears hurt. Which department should I go to?
lines.roman: Nuni apeugo gwido apayo. Eoneu gwaro gaya haeyo?

lines.en: It has hurt since I went swimming last weekend.

lines.beaver_en: Go to ophthalmology for your eyes and ENT for your ears.
lines.learner: 네, 안과에서 안약도 받을 수 있어요?
lines.en: Okay. Can I get eye drops at ophthalmology too?
lines.roman: Ne, angwaeseo anyakdo badeul su isseoyo?

lines.beaver: 네, 의사 선생님이 처방해 주실 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, the doctor will prescribe them.
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, uisa seonsaengnimi cheobanghae jusil geoyeyo.
lines.en: Also, I fell and hurt my knee.

lines.beaver_en: Oh no, does it hurt a lot?
lines.learner: 조금요. 외과로 가야 해요, 정형외과로 가야 해요?
lines.en: A little. Should I go to surgery or orthopedics?
lines.roman: Jogeumyo. Oegwaro gaya haeyo, jeonghyeongoegwaro gaya haeyo?

lines.beaver_en: Bone pain is orthopedics; wounds are surgery.
lines.learner: 상처만 있어요. 소독하고 연고를 바르면 돼요?
lines.en: It's just a wound. Do I just disinfect it and put ointment on?
lines.roman: Sangcheoman isseoyo. Sodokago yeongoreul bareumyeon dwaeyo?

lines.beaver_en: A nurse in surgery will disinfect it for you.
Next to surgery on the 2nd floor. Do you need a medical certificate?
lines.beaver_roman: Icheung oegwa yeope isseoyo. Jindanseodo piryohaseyo?
lines.en: Yes, I need a medical certificate for my company.

lines.beaver: 진단서는 진료 때 말씀하시고, 약은 1층 약국이에요.
lines.beaver_en: Ask for the certificate during your visit. The pharmacy is on the 1st floor.
lines.beaver_roman: Jindanseoneun jillyo ttae malsseumhasigo, yageun ilcheung yakgugieyo.
lines.learner: 약국에서 약 먹는 방법도 알려 줘요?
lines.en: Will the pharmacy tell me how to take the medicine?
lines.roman: Yakgugeseo yak meongneun bangbeopdo allyeo jwoyo?

lines.beaver: 네, 약사가 자세히 설명해 줄 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, the pharmacist will explain it in detail.
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, yaksaga jasehi seolmyeonghae jul geoyeyo.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll also ask how to prevent eye infections.
